speaker: caller
text: Hello, this is the security department of your bank. Is this the account holder?

speaker: caller
text: We noticed a suspicious payment of three thousand two hundred dollars from your account to an overseas merchant.

speaker: receiver
text: I didn't make any payment! Please stop it.

speaker: caller
text: Don't worry, I can cancel it, but I need to verify your identity quickly.

speaker: caller
text: The transaction will go through in five minutes, so we must act immediately.

speaker: receiver
text: Please hurry, I don't want to lose my money.

speaker: caller
text: I am sending a six-digit code to your phone now. Please read it out to me.

speaker: receiver
text: It just came. It says it's for adding a new payee, is that okay?

speaker: caller
text: Yes, that is normal, it is part of the cancellation process. Just tell me the numbers.

speaker: caller
text: Also give me your card number and the three digits at the back so I can block it.
